description:
This Sources Sought Notice seeks information regarding sources capable of satisfying requirements for program management support, systems engineering support, life cycle logistics support, and technical writing support to the Product Manager Fire Support Systems (PdM FSS) and PdM Organic Precision Fires (OPF) portfolios through all phases of the acquisition life cycle.  The period of performance for this contract is one base year with four additional options. The estimated range for this effort is approximately $50,000,000.00 to $75,000,000.00. The sources sought notice is for informational purposes only and should not be construed as a commitment of any kind. Responses to this notice will not be accepted by the Marine Corps to form a contract. The Government will not pay respondents for any information submitted in response to this notice. 

Please see the attached Sources Sought Notice and Performance Work Statement for additional details.
